I saved the draft mail to Tobias and confirmed it to June in this DM. Nothing has been sent; someone still needs to review it and send it.

- To: trendle@pemberline.com (Tobias's address in the directory). The address is internal, so Ruth's approval isn't needed.
- Subject: "Tansley Parcel: proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: gives $1,313 per seat as the proposed 2027 rate for Pemberline Dock. It says the rate is proposed, not signed, that the signed renewal runs to January 31, 2027, and that June cleared sharing it. It asks Tobias to keep it internal.
- I signed it as Pree, because her request was for a mail from her.

June's approval covers putting the rate in this draft. The $1,313 figure comes from June's message as Pree gave it. I couldn't find that figure in any record I have.
